name: The Shops at Montebello
description: The Shops at Montebello is a premier regional shopping destination serving the greater Los Angeles area, featuring a diverse mix of national retailers, dining options, and entertainment venues. This enclosed mall offers a comfortable shopping experience with popular anchors and specialty stores catering to the diverse Montebello community. Conveniently located with easy freeway access, it serves as a central retail hub for the San Gabriel Valley.
demographics: Serves a predominantly Hispanic community in the San Gabriel Valley with diverse middle-income families and multigenerational shoppers.
summary: A major enclosed regional mall in Montebello serving the diverse San Gabriel Valley community with over 100 stores and restaurants.
